method.workload: 180s 44.1kHz stereo PCM16, repeated verse fixture, 32 inference chunks; 12s for cancel/retry and forced Web fallback
method.ui: actual 1600x1000 settings page, balanced fluid background, wheel input every 100ms with alternating direction
method.visibility: test main-window background throttling and fluid pauseOnBlur disabled to keep rendering while focus changes
method.frameMetric: requestAnimationFrame interval plus main-thread longtask observer; >50ms counts normalized by generation wall time
method.admission: only measurement entry simulates 16GiB total for admission reserve to permit a second isolated app alongside the existing developer app; actual free/file-backed/purgeable values unchanged; production resource guard unchanged
method.scope: single-machine single-run cases; not a memory-admission, GPU-memory-cap or cross-platform benchmark
method.control: source snapshot before pacing/priority change; all 180s comparisons actually completed 32 native GPU calls; incomplete warmups excluded

variants.priority: PRIORITY_LOW (19) plus removal of disable-renderer-backgrounding, no rest
variants.paced: priority variant plus 400ms delay after native infer
variants.pacing-only: original priority/background flags plus 900ms delay after native infer
variants.final: production helper BELOW_NORMAL (10), original renderer-backgrounding switch retained; next inference waits until 3x previous elapsed time after completion (100–1500ms), CPU post/preprocessing included in rest
variants.cancel-retry: production code, cancel after first GPU result during rest then enqueue immediately
variants.web-fallback: production pacing, native-init forced false only in measurement helper entry

validation.regressionBefore: two new pacing/cancel tests failed before fix
validation.productionBuild: not rerun; actual npm run dev exercised current main/preload/worker
